title: A graph node has no implementation; the design is view only
message: The graph node {graph_node} ({op}) has no implementation, so the design is view only.
basic_text: Part of this design can be shown but not run.
fix_text: Replace the block with one Rastai can run.

title: Smoke forward shape differs from the inferred shape
message: The smoke forward gave shape {found_shape} at {graph_node}, but the inferred shape is {expected_shape}.
basic_text: Rastai's model builder made a mistake. This is a bug, not something you did.
fix_text: Please report this bug with the design file.

title: Compiled parameter count differs from live stats
message: The compiled model has {compiled_count} parameters, but the live stats said {stats_count}.
basic_text: The parameter count shown while designing was wrong. This is a bug.
fix_text: Please report this bug with the design file.

title: Designer command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: A tied output layer ran before its embedding weight was bound
message: The output layer of this design ran before it was linked to the embedding's weight.
basic_text: The design's output layer has no weights yet, so the model can't compute its answers.
fix_text: Report this as a bug; the design itself is fine.

title: Graph nodes without Eject or ONNX support
message: These graph nodes have no Eject or ONNX support: {graph_nodes}.
basic_text: Some blocks in this design can't be exported.
fix_text: Replace those blocks, or export a format that supports them.

title: ONNX lowering failed for a graph node
message: ONNX lowering failed for {graph_node}: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't convert part of this model to ONNX.
fix_text: Report the problem with the design file.

title: ONNX round trip differs beyond tolerance; file kept as unverified
message: The ONNX round trip differs by {difference}, beyond the tolerance of {tolerance}; the file is kept as unverified.
basic_text: The exported ONNX file gives slightly different answers from the original, so it is marked unverified.

title: Ejected code doesn't reproduce the compiled model, or imports rastai
message: The ejected code doesn't reproduce the compiled model, or imports rastai: {reason}.
basic_text: The exported PyTorch code doesn't behave like the original model. This is a bug.
fix_text: Please report this bug with the design file.

title: No in-house family; the compat runtime can run this model
message: {model_name} has no in-house family; the compat runtime can run it.
basic_text: Rastai can run this model, but can only look at it from the outside.

title: The compat runtime isn't installed in this environment
message: The compat runtime isn't installed in the {environment} environment.
basic_text: The extra software this model needs isn't installed.
fix_text: Install the compat group for this environment.

title: The model needs remote code; refused
message: {model_name} needs remote code; it is refused.
basic_text: This model only runs with its own downloaded code, which Rastai never runs.
fix_text: Pick another model, or a version of it that needs no remote code.

title: Weights not found in the HF cache or the blob store; nothing is downloaded
message: The weights of {model_name} are not in the Hugging Face cache or the blob store; nothing is downloaded.
basic_text: This model's weights aren't on this computer.
fix_text: Download the model first.

title: The weights lack tensors the ModelSpec needs
message: The weights lack tensors the ModelSpec needs: {tensor_names}.
basic_text: The weights file is missing parts this model needs.
fix_text: Check that the weights belong to this model.

title: The weights hold tensors the ModelSpec doesn't use
message: The weights hold tensors the ModelSpec doesn't use: {tensor_names}.
basic_text: The weights file has parts this model doesn't use.
fix_text: Check that the weights belong to this model.

title: Tensor shape mismatch
message: Tensor {tensor_name} has shape {found_shape}, but the ModelSpec needs {expected_shape}.
basic_text: A weight in this file is the wrong size for this model.
fix_text: Check that the weights belong to this model.

title: Weights exist only in pickle format; refused
message: The weights of {model_name} exist only in pickle format; they are refused.
basic_text: This model's weights are in a format that can run code when it loads, so Rastai refuses them.
fix_text: Use a version of the model with safetensors weights.

title: Non-finite logits in the smoke forward
message: The smoke forward of {model_name} gave non-finite logits.
basic_text: This model gave broken numbers on a test input.
fix_text: Check the weights and the dtype.

title: Reference parity outside tolerance
message: {model_name} differs from the reference by {difference} in {dtype}, beyond the tolerance of {tolerance}.
basic_text: This model's answers differ too much from the original implementation.
fix_text: Report the problem with the model's name.

title: Reference parity skipped; the compat group isn't installed
message: The reference parity check was skipped because the compat group isn't installed.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't compare this model with the original implementation.
fix_text: Install the compat group to run the check.

title: CUDA graph capture failed; eager decode in use
message: CUDA graph capture failed for {model_name}; eager decode is in use.
basic_text: This model works, but chat will be a little slower.

title: Doesn't fit the chosen GPUs
message: {model_name} needs {needed_bytes} bytes but the chosen GPUs have {free_bytes} free.
basic_text: This model doesn't fit on the graphics cards you picked.
fix_text: Pick more GPUs, or a smaller or quantized model.

title: One placement unit is larger than any GPU
message: {unit_name} needs {needed_bytes} bytes, more than any GPU has.
basic_text: One part of this model is too big for any of your graphics cards.
fix_text: Use a smaller or quantized model.

title: The dtype isn't supported on every chosen GPU
message: {dtype} isn't supported on GPU {gpu_index}.
basic_text: One of the graphics cards you picked can't use this number format.
fix_text: Pick other GPUs, or another dtype.

title: Out of memory loading a placement unit on GPU n
message: Out of memory loading {unit_name} on GPU {gpu_index}.
basic_text: A graphics card ran out of memory while loading the model.
fix_text: Free GPU memory, or pick another placement.
